seo_principles.name: People-first content
seo_principles.rule: Create accurate, useful content that answers real user needs rather than content primarily designed to manipulate rankings.

seo_principles.name: Evidence and credibility
seo_principles.rule: Support important health claims with appropriate sources, qualified review, and transparent attribution.

seo_principles.name: Search intent alignment
seo_principles.rule: Match page content and structure to the purpose of the search.

seo_principles.name: Unique page value
seo_principles.rule: Avoid generating many substantially similar pages without meaningful differences.

seo_principles.name: Metadata
seo_principles.rule: Create descriptive, relevant page titles and meta descriptions without keyword stuffing.

seo_principles.name: Internal linking
seo_principles.rule: Connect related services, providers, locations, products, and resources where helpful.

seo_principles.name: Technical discoverability
seo_principles.rule: Check crawlability, indexability, canonical URLs, redirects, and relevant sitemap entries.

seo_principles.name: Mobile and performance
seo_principles.rule: Provide usable mobile experiences and monitor performance with appropriate metrics.

restrictions: Do not invent keyword search volume.
Do not assume structured data guarantees rich results.
Do not treat an AI-generated article as expert-reviewed.
Do not claim a page meets search quality standards solely because it follows a template.
